rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an edge or rim around an object.

example.english: The rim of the cup is chipped.
example.jyutping: go3 bui1 bin1 bang1 zo2 jat1 gok3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the rim of a vehicle or bicycle wheel.

example.english: The rim on this bicycle is bent.
example.jyutping: ne1 gaa3 daan1 ce1 ge3 leon4 hyun1 waai1 zo2
